sql: SELECT d.company_name, COUNT(f.listing_key) AS open_remote_us_data_listings FROM fct_posting AS f JOIN dim_company AS d ON f.company_key = d.company_key WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing GROUP BY d.company_name ORDER BY open_remote_us_data_listings DESC LIMIT 3
